title: Aadhaar PDF password

scenes.screen: Aadhaar PDF password? You already know it.
scenes.screen_hi: Aadhaar PDF ka password? Aapko pehle se pata hai.
scenes.voice: Your Aadhaar P D F password? You already know it.
scenes.say: Your Aadhaar PDF password? You already know it.
scenes.voice_hi: आधार पीडीएफ का पासवर्ड? आपको पहले से पता है।
scenes.say_hi: Aadhaar PDF ka password? Aapko pehle se pata hai.

scenes.label: ENTER PASSWORD
scenes.voice: You open the file. It asks for a password.
scenes.say: You open the file. It asks for a password.
scenes.voice_hi: फाइल खोली। पासवर्ड माँग रही है।
scenes.say_hi: File kholi. Password maang rahi hai.

scenes.label: NOT THE OTP
scenes.voice: Not the O T P. Not your Aadhaar number.
scenes.say: Not the OTP. Not your Aadhaar number.
scenes.voice_hi: ओ टी पी नहीं। आधार नंबर भी नहीं।
scenes.say_hi: OTP nahi. Aadhaar number bhi nahi.

scenes.label: NAME: RAHUL
scenes.voice: First four letters of your name. In capitals.
scenes.say: First 4 letters of your name. In CAPITALS.
scenes.voice_hi: नाम के पहले चार अक्षर। कैपिटल में।
scenes.say_hi: Naam ke pehle 4 letter. CAPITAL mein.

scenes.label: BORN: 1998
scenes.voice: Then your year of birth. That is it.
scenes.say: Then your year of birth. That's it.
scenes.voice_hi: फिर जन्म का साल। बस इतना।
scenes.say_hi: Phir janm ka saal. Bas itna.

scenes.label: BONUS
scenes.voice: Tired of typing it? Remove it at I love documents dot A I.
scenes.say: Tired of typing it? Remove it at ilovedocuments.ai
scenes.voice_hi: हर बार पासवर्ड डालना है? आई लव डॉक्यूमेंट्स डॉट ए आई पर हटा दो।
scenes.say_hi: Har baar password daalna hai? ilovedocuments.ai par hata do.

scenes.screen: Save this. You will need it.
scenes.voice: Save this. You will need it again.
scenes.say: Save this. You will need it again.
scenes.voice_hi: सेव कर लो। अगली बार काम आएगा।
scenes.say_hi: Save kar lo. Agli baar kaam aayega.

caption:
Aadhaar PDF ka password kya hota hai? 🔐

Answer: naam ke pehle 4 letter CAPITAL mein + janm ka saal.
Rahul, 1998 → RAHU1998

📌 Save kar lo, har baar kaam aayega.
💬 Kis document mein sabse zyada dikkat aati hai? Comment karo.

Password hatana ho to: ilovedocuments.ai
